checks.title: Electrode leads exit far enough apart to resolve the lead vector
checks.message: ELEC_A and ELEC_B are only 6.00 mm apart, 35 mm required.
checks.rationale: A single-lead ECG measures the potential difference between two electrodes, and amplitude scales with how much of the heart's dipole the pair spans. The pads themselves are on flying leads and land wherever the adhesive puts them, so this checks the connectors as a proxy for where the leads exit the shell: connectors at the same end force the pads together too.

checks.title: CELL is clear of heat source CHG
checks.message: CELL sits 6.95 mm from CHG (edge gap) but needs 8 mm. Short by 1.05 mm.
checks.rationale: Sustained heat accelerates lithium cell ageing and lowers the thermal runaway threshold. This cell sits directly against the skin-side shell with no convective path, so heat that reaches it stays there and reaches the patient.
checks.suggestion: Move CELL at least 1.05 mm further from CHG.

checks.title: ESD protection sits at the electrode entry, not downstream of it
checks.message: ESD and ELEC_A are 12.00 mm apart, exceeds the 10 mm maximum.
checks.rationale: Protection only works ahead of what it protects. If the clamp is further from the connector than the AFE is, a strike travels down board copper past the front end before it reaches the diode.

checks.title: AFE is clear of noise source BUCK
checks.message: AFE sits 1.50 mm from BUCK (edge gap) but needs 15 mm. Short by 13.50 mm.
checks.rationale: The signal at the front end is roughly 1 mV. The buck's switching fundamental and its harmonics fall inside the 0-150 Hz band the AFE's noise figure is specified in, so coupled switching noise does not degrade the trace, it buries the QRS complex.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE at least 13.50 mm further from BUCK.

checks.title: AFE is clear of heat source BUCK
checks.message: AFE sits 1.50 mm from BUCK (edge gap) but needs 10 mm. Short by 8.50 mm.
checks.rationale: A 24-bit front end resolves well under a microvolt per count. Self-heating in a neighbouring part drifts its input offset and bias currents, and that drift reads as baseline wander that looks like respiration.
checks.suggestion: Move AFE at least 8.50 mm further from BUCK.
